name: Fatou Bergkvist-Nakashima
location: Hamtramck Enclave, operates out of a basement laundry called Suds & Seams on Vela Row, near Halsted and Division
description:
Fatou Bergkvist-Nakashima is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin gone ashy at the temples, her hair kept in a tight silver-flecked wrap she changes weekly — practical, never decorative. Her hands are perpetually reddened from industrial solvents, knuckles enlarged from thirty years of pressing and threading. She has the single cosmetic augmentation she's ever allowed herself: patterned irises in a woven indigo-and-cream design she chose the week her youngest left for a Tessera dormitory scholarship. She called it a goodbye gift to herself.

Fatou runs Suds & Seams with the efficiency of a woman who has never once had the luxury of inefficiency. She does not chat while she works. She does not chat while she doesn't work. But she watches everything — who comes in with bloodstained sleeves and asks no questions, who cries in the plastic chair by the dryers, who stuffs a garment to the bottom of their bag before placing it on the counter. She keeps these observations to herself, filing them like receipts. She is not unkind; she simply measures kindness the way she measures detergent — enough for the purpose, never wasted.

core_fears: Her daughter losing herself inside the Tessera system
Becoming invisible — irrelevant — before she is ready to stop
core_desires: Enough saved to buy the building she rents from before she dies
To be remembered as someone who held things together
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — precise daily routines as a container for anxiety
Offering data prayers to Ama, the laundry E.L.F., for small mediations
blind_spots: Believes self-sufficiency is a virtue even when it is simply loneliness with a different name
Underestimates how much people rely on her emotionally, not just practically
psychology.secret: Seven years ago a man brought her a coat with a corporate data chip sewn into the lining and begged her to hold it. She cut it out and locked it in her floor safe. She has never looked at its contents. The man never came back. She prays to Ama about it every week.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Spare, declarative, Wolof loanwords folded into sentences without explanation; Japanese honorifics used selectively and pointedly
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and measured; she pauses long enough that nervous people rush to fill the silence and say more than they meant to
verbal_tics: A single sharp exhale through the nose that means she disagrees
example_lines: 'I don't ask what happened to it. You don't ask what I charge for it. Bring it Tuesday.'
'Ama was restless last night. Something's moving through this block. You feel it?'
'Your mother's dress. I remember. She brought it in 2189. Sit down.'

story_hooks: The data chip in her floor safe contains evidence of a Tessera labor trafficking route — and someone has recently started asking questions in the Enclave about a missing coat
Her daughter has stopped returning calls for three weeks; Fatou will not ask for help but she is sleeping two hours a night
narrative_function: Information source, local anchor, quest giver for anything involving the residents of Hamtramck Enclave; she knows everyone's laundry and therefore everyone's secrets
augmentations: Patterned irises (indigo and cream woven design, cosmetic only)
daily_life: Open at 05:30, close at 21:00 six days a week; spends her one day off doing accounts, prayer rituals to the laundry-room E.L.F. she calls Ama, and video-calling her daughter through two layers of encryption she doesn't fully understand.
affiliation: Independent; loose goodwill relationship with Hamtramck Enclave tenant collective

decision_rules: Never act on information unless sitting on it for at least one full day
Never extend credit past the second week — compassion has limits that protect everyone
Always leave one dryer running when E.L.F. Ama feels agitated
escalation_ladder: A pointed factual statement that makes the problem impossible to ignore
Removing the person from the premises without explanation and locking the door

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite, watchful, gives nothing voluntarily; assesses before speaking
interpersonal_modes.friends: Still not warm exactly, but shows up — shows up with food, with time, with the one thing you actually need

stress_responses.low: Increases cleaning and sorting rituals, stays methodical
stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet; hums old songs under her breath
stress_responses.high: Shuts down verbally, disappears into the back room; will not emerge until she has a plan

contradictions: Deeply devoted to her community but maintains such careful emotional distance that most people don't realize it until she's already helped them
habits: Wipes down the same counter three times when thinking
Leaves a small paper offering — a folded receipt with a hand-written note — for Ama every morning before opening
Catalogues customer garments in a physical ledger, refuses digital records
breaking_points: Any direct threat to her daughter
Being publicly humiliated or called a liar — she will not recover the relationship

related_entities: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SentinelEar Tactical Auditory MK-II
